description: Implementation of the AdbWinUsbEndpointObject class, which manages a WinUsb endpoint, including handle management, asynchronous and synchronous read/write operations, and cleanup procedures.

classes.name: AdbWinUsbEndpointObject
classes.description: Manages a WinUsb endpoint, handling I/O operations, resource cleanup, and synchronization.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count and deletes object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes the endpoint handle, aborts pending I/O, and releases resources safely.

methods.name: CommonAsyncReadWrite
methods.description: Performs asynchronous read or write operation on the endpoint.

methods.name: CommonSyncReadWrite
methods.description: Performs synchronous read or write operation on the endpoint.

methods.name: SetTimeout
methods.description: Sets the transfer timeout policy for the endpoint.
